Implemented `outage_refund` in `ledgerly/adjustments.py`:

- Rounds the amount and rejects non-positive values (`non_positive_amount`).
- Requires the payment to be `captured` (`invalid_state`).
- Rejects refunds exceeding the captured amount (`refund_exceeds_captured`).
- Accumulates `payment.refunded_amount`, sets status to `"refunded"` when fully refunded, records an audit event, and returns the payment.

All 10 tests pass, and edge cases were verified.
